summary: A countdown timer for meetings. The user picks 15, 30, or 60 minutes and starts the countdown; the remaining minutes are shown in the window and in the system tray, and a desktop notification appears when the time is up. The last chosen duration is remembered on the device and restored after restart.
targetUsers: People running meetings who need a visible time limit
Facilitators and presenters who keep the timer in view while working in other windows
goals: Start a meeting countdown in one action from a small set of durations
Keep the remaining minutes visible both in the window and in the system tray
Notify the user on the desktop when the countdown reaches zero
Remember the last chosen duration across restarts

features.name: Start countdown
features.userOutcome: A meeting countdown runs for the chosen duration and the user can stop it early.
features.trigger: The user picks a duration and presses Start.
features.behavior: The window offers a duration choice list named Duration with options 15 minutes, 30 minutes, and 60 minutes, initially set to the last chosen duration restored from the device, or 15 minutes when none has been stored. Pressing Start begins a countdown from the chosen duration; the remaining time is computed from the start moment and the chosen duration. While running, the Start button is replaced by a Stop button; pressing Stop ends the countdown and the remaining time returns to the full chosen duration. Starting a new countdown while one is running replaces the running countdown. The chosen duration is saved to the device each time Start is pressed.
features.failureOutcome: If the chosen duration cannot be saved, the countdown still starts and the previously stored duration remains unchanged.
acceptanceSignals: Pressing Start with 30 minutes selected makes the countdown report 30 remaining minutes at the start moment.
Pressing Stop during a running countdown returns the remaining time to the full chosen duration.
After pressing Start with 60 minutes selected, reading the stored duration returns 60 minutes.

features.name: Show remaining time
features.userOutcome: The user sees the remaining minutes in the window and in the system tray while the countdown runs.
features.behavior: The window shows the remaining time as whole minutes rounded up, written as a number followed by ' min' (for example '12 min'), and the system tray shows the same value. When no countdown is running, the window shows the full chosen duration in the same format and the tray shows the same value. The display updates every second while the app is open.
features.failureOutcome: If the tray icon cannot be created, the window still shows the remaining time and the app continues running.
acceptanceSignals: With a 15 minute countdown started at a given moment, the displayed remaining time at 5 minutes after the start reads '10 min'.
With no countdown running and 30 minutes chosen, the displayed remaining time reads '30 min'.
The tray status value equals the window's displayed remaining time at the same moment.

features.name: Notify when time is up
features.userOutcome: A desktop notification tells the user the meeting time is over.
features.behavior: When a running countdown reaches zero, the app sends one desktop notification titled 'Time is up' with the body 'Your meeting countdown has finished.' and the countdown stops, leaving the remaining time at '0 min'. The notification is sent once per countdown; a countdown that has already notified does not notify again.
features.failureOutcome: If the notification cannot be delivered, the countdown still stops at zero and the window shows '0 min'.
acceptanceSignals: When a running countdown reaches zero, the app requests a desktop notification titled 'Time is up' with the body 'Your meeting countdown has finished.'.
After a countdown reaches zero, the displayed remaining time reads '0 min'.
A countdown that has reached zero does not request a second notification.

dataObjects.name: Last chosen duration
dataObjects.purpose: Remembers the duration the user last started so it is restored after restart.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user starts a countdown with a different duration.

qualityRequirements: The remaining time display updates every second while the app is open.
The window and the system tray show the same remaining time value at any moment.
productConstraints: Only the three durations 15, 30, and 60 minutes are offered.
Only one countdown runs at a time.
